pictures.author: Jean-Pierre Dalbéra
pictures.observations: Actually inspected full west view: three pink-sandstone towers on a stepped plinth, central tower higher, stacked receding roof storeys, upper corner aedicules, lotus/bulb finials, curved pediment frames, false west door panels and dense worn reliefs. Foreground sculptures are independent objects, not copied into generic portrait reliefs.

pictures.observations: Actually inspected full moat/enclosure view: native water and grassy/eroded bank, low surviving laterite/sandstone enclosure, pointed/curved gopura pediments and the three sanctuary towers behind. Exact small-wall damage and gateway dimensions are estimates; no photo pixels ship.

mappedTags.description: A temple in the forest 25 kilometres to the north east of Angkor Thom. A jewel to which the nature of the material used - a finely textured rose coloured sandstone - is perfectly suited.
